# Kleene's Theorem: DFA to Regular Expression

This notebook focuses on the state-elimination half of Kleene's theorem.
For a DFA with numbered states $q_1,\ldots,q_n$, the construction defines
$R_{i,j}^k$ as the set of words that take the automaton from $q_i$ to
$q_j$ while using only $q_1,\ldots,q_k$ as intermediate states.

The key recurrence is:
$$
  R_{i,j}^k =
  R_{i,j}^{k-1}
  +
  R_{i,k}^{k-1}(R_{k,k}^{k-1})^*R_{k,j}^{k-1}.
$$

Read it as: either avoid the newly allowed state $q_k$, or enter $q_k$,
loop around it any finite number of times, and then exit.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const EPS = "\u03b5";
  const EMPTY = "\u2205";

  const presets = {
    parity: {
      description: "q1 is even and accepting; q2 is odd. Reading a toggles, reading b stays.",
      states: ["q1", "q2"],
      alphabet: ["a", "b"],
      initial: "q1",
      finals: ["q1"],
      transitions: {
        q1: { a: "q2", b: "q1" },
        q2: { a: "q1", b: "q2" }
      }
    },
    seenA: {
      description: "q1 means no a has been seen; q2 means at least one a has been seen and is accepting.",
      states: ["q1", "q2"],
      alphabet: ["a", "b"],
      initial: "q1",
      finals: ["q2"],
      transitions: {
        q1: { a: "q2", b: "q1" },
        q2: { a: "q2", b: "q2" }
      }
    }
  };

  const presetSelect = document.getElementById("ke-preset");
  const kSelect = document.getElementById("ke-k");
  const iSelect = document.getElementById("ke-i");
  const jSelect = document.getElementById("ke-j");
  const description = document.getElementById("ke-description");
  const selected = document.getElementById("ke-selected");
  const components = document.getElementById("ke-components");
  const examples = document.getElementById("ke-examples");
  const wordInput = document.getElementById("ke-word");
  const trace = document.getElementById("ke-trace");
  const verdict = document.getElementById("ke-verdict");
  const legend = document.getElementById("ke-node-legend");

  function stateNumber(state) {
    return Number(state.slice(1));
  }

  function labelR(i, j, k) {
    return "R_" + stateNumber(i) + "," + stateNumber(j) + "^" + k;
  }

  function unionExpr(a, b) {
    if (a === EMPTY) return b;
    if (b === EMPTY) return a;
    if (a === b) return a;
    return a + " + " + b;
  }

  function unionMany(parts) {
    return parts.reduce((acc, part) => unionExpr(acc, part), EMPTY);
  }

  function wrapConcat(expr) {
    if (expr === EPS || expr === EMPTY) return expr;
    if (/^[ab]$/.test(expr)) return expr;
    if (/^[ab]\*$/.test(expr)) return expr;
    if (/^\(.+\)\*$/.test(expr)) return expr;
    return "(" + expr + ")";
  }

  function concatExpr() {
    const parts = Array.from(arguments);
    if (parts.some((part) => part === EMPTY)) return EMPTY;
    const real = parts.filter((part) => part !== EPS);
    if (real.length === 0) return EPS;
    return real.map(wrapConcat).join("");
  }

  function starExpr(expr) {
    if (expr === EMPTY || expr === EPS) return EPS;
    if (/^[ab]$/.test(expr)) return expr + "*";
    return "(" + expr + ")*";
  }

  function buildExpressions(aut) {
    const levels = [];
    levels[0] = {};
    aut.states.forEach((from) => {
      levels[0][from] = {};
      aut.states.forEach((to) => {
        const parts = [];
        if (from === to) parts.push(EPS);
        aut.alphabet.forEach((symbol) => {
          if (aut.transitions[from][symbol] === to) parts.push(symbol);
        });
        levels[0][from][to] = unionMany(parts);
      });
    });

    for (let k = 1; k <= aut.states.length; k += 1) {
      const qk = aut.states[k - 1];
      levels[k] = {};
      aut.states.forEach((from) => {
        levels[k][from] = {};
        aut.states.forEach((to) => {
          const direct = levels[k - 1][from][to];
          const via = concatExpr(
            levels[k - 1][from][qk],
            starExpr(levels[k - 1][qk][qk]),
            levels[k - 1][qk][to]
          );
          levels[k][from][to] = unionExpr(direct, via);
        });
      });
    }
    return levels;
  }

  function runFrom(aut, start, word) {
    const states = [start];
    let current = start;
    for (const symbol of word) {
      current = aut.transitions[current][symbol];
      states.push(current);
    }
    return { states, end: current };
  }

  function belongsToR(aut, start, end, k, word) {
    const result = runFrom(aut, start, word);
    if (result.end !== end) return false;
    for (let pos = 1; pos < result.states.length - 1; pos += 1) {
      if (stateNumber(result.states[pos]) > k) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function allWords(alphabet, maxLength) {
    const words = [""];
    let layer = [""];
    for (let length = 1; length <= maxLength; length += 1) {
      const next = [];
      layer.forEach((prefix) => {
        alphabet.forEach((symbol) => next.push(prefix + symbol));
      });
      words.push.apply(words, next);
      layer = next;
    }
    return words;
  }

  function wordLabel(word) {
    return word === "" ? EPS : word;
  }

  function sanitizeWord(value, aut) {
    const allowed = new RegExp("[^" + aut.alphabet.join("") + "]", "g");
    return value.toLowerCase().replace(allowed, "");
  }

  function activeAut() {
    return presets[presetSelect.value];
  }

  function populateControls() {
    const aut = activeAut();
    kSelect.innerHTML = "";
    for (let k = 0; k <= aut.states.length; k += 1) {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = String(k);
      option.textContent = String(k);
      kSelect.appendChild(option);
    }
    kSelect.value = String(aut.states.length);

    [iSelect, jSelect].forEach((select) => {
      select.innerHTML = "";
      aut.states.forEach((state) => {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = state;
        option.textContent = state;
        select.appendChild(option);
      });
    });
    iSelect.value = aut.initial;
    jSelect.value = aut.finals[0];
  }

  function renderGraph(aut, i, j, k) {
    aut.states.forEach((state) => {
      const node = document.querySelector("[data-node='" + state + "']");
      node.classList.toggle("allowed", stateNumber(state) <= k && k > 0);
      node.classList.toggle("accept", aut.finals.includes(state));
      node.classList.toggle("start", state === i);
      node.classList.toggle("end", state === j);
    });

    aut.states.forEach((from) => {
      aut.states.forEach((to) => {
        const edgeId = from + "-" + to;
        const symbols = aut.alphabet.filter((symbol) => aut.transitions[from][symbol] === to);
        const edge = document.querySelector("[data-edge='" + edgeId + "']");
        const label = document.querySelector("[data-label='" + edgeId + "']");
        if (!edge || !label) return;
        edge.classList.toggle("hidden", symbols.length === 0);
        label.classList.toggle("hidden", symbols.length === 0);
        label.textContent = symbols.join(",");
      });
    });

    legend.innerHTML = "";
    [
      ["start", i],
      ["end", j],
      ["allowed intermediates", k === 0 ? "none" : aut.states.slice(0, k).join(", ")],
      ["accepting", aut.finals.join(", ")]
    ].forEach(([name, value]) => {
      const badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "ke-badge";
      badge.textContent = name + ": " + value;
      legend.appendChild(badge);
    });
  }

  function renderComponents(aut, levels, i, j, k) {
    components.innerHTML = "";
    if (k === 0) {
      const p = document.createElement("p");
      p.className = "ke-desc";
      p.textContent = "At k = 0 there are no intermediate states. Only epsilon on the diagonal and direct one-symbol transitions can appear.";
      components.appendChild(p);
      return;
    }

    const qk = aut.states[k - 1];
    const rows = [
      ["avoid q" + k, labelR(i, j, k - 1), levels[k - 1][i][j]],
      ["enter q" + k, labelR(i, qk, k - 1), levels[k - 1][i][qk]],
      ["repeat at q" + k, "(" + labelR(qk, qk, k - 1) + ")*", starExpr(levels[k - 1][qk][qk])],
      ["exit q" + k, labelR(qk, j, k - 1), levels[k - 1][qk][j]]
    ];

    const table = document.createElement("table");
    table.className = "ke-table";
    table.innerHTML = "<thead><tr><th>Part</th><th>Symbol</th><th>Expression</th></tr></thead>";
    const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      row.forEach((cell) => {
        const td = document.createElement("td");
        td.textContent = cell;
        tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
    table.appendChild(tbody);
    components.appendChild(table);
  }

  function renderExamples(aut, i, j, k) {
    examples.innerHTML = "";
    const hits = allWords(aut.alphabet, 4).filter((word) => belongsToR(aut, i, j, k, word));
    if (hits.length === 0) {
      const badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "ke-badge warn";
      badge.textContent = "no words up to length 4";
      examples.appendChild(badge);
      return;
    }
    hits.forEach((word) => {
      const badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "ke-badge";
      badge.textContent = wordLabel(word);
      examples.appendChild(badge);
    });
  }

  function renderWordTest(aut, i, j, k) {
    const clean = sanitizeWord(wordInput.value, aut);
    if (clean !== wordInput.value) wordInput.value = clean;
    const result = runFrom(aut, i, clean);
    const selectedHit = belongsToR(aut, i, j, k, clean);
    const languageRun = runFrom(aut, aut.initial, clean);
    const accepted = aut.finals.includes(languageRun.end);

    trace.innerHTML = "";
    result.states.forEach((state, pos) => {
      const item = document.createElement("span");
      const isProperIntermediate = pos > 0 && pos < result.states.length - 1;
      const violates = isProperIntermediate && stateNumber(state) > k;
      item.className = "ke-step" + (violates ? " bad" : "");
      item.textContent = pos === 0 ? state : clean[pos - 1] + " -> " + state;
      trace.appendChild(item);
    });

    const selectedText = selectedHit ? "belongs to " : "does not belong to ";
    const acceptedText = accepted ? "accepted by the DFA" : "rejected by the DFA";
    verdict.textContent =
      wordLabel(clean) + " " + selectedText + labelR(i, j, k) +
      "; from the real initial state it is " + acceptedText + ".";
  }

  function render() {
    const aut = activeAut();
    const k = Number(kSelect.value);
    const i = iSelect.value;
    const j = jSelect.value;
    const levels = buildExpressions(aut);
    description.textContent = aut.description;
    selected.textContent = labelR(i, j, k) + " = " + levels[k][i][j];
    renderGraph(aut, i, j, k);
    renderComponents(aut, levels, i, j, k);
    renderExamples(aut, i, j, k);
    renderWordTest(aut, i, j, k);
  }

  presetSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
    populateControls();
    render();
  });
  [kSelect, iSelect, jSelect].forEach((select) => select.addEventListener("change", render));
  wordInput.addEventListener("input", render);

  populateControls();
  render();
})();
</script>
```

## What To Notice

The parameter $k$ does not count how many states the run may visit.  It
sets which state names may occur in the middle of the run.  When $k$
increases by one, the recurrence adds exactly the words whose path uses
the newly unlocked state $q_k$ as an intermediate stop.

The star appears because once a run reaches $q_k$, it may return to
$q_k$ zero, one, two, or any finite number of times before leaving.
